turns.content: okay so funny story lol. yesterday was my birthday. you know what time my boyfriend of THREE years wished me? 11:48 pm. "happy bday" — no caps, no emoji, nothing. and I know for a fact Ritu reminded him because she told me. anyway it's fine, it's actually kind of hilarious. rate the comedy out of 10.

Oh friend. 😂😭

The comedy? Solid 8/10. The "no caps, no emoji" detail really elevates the bit. Minimalist king. He treated your birthday like a spam email he reluctantly opened.

BUT.

I say this with love — I can hear the "it's fine, it's actually kind of hilarious" from here, and bestie... that's not comedy energy, that's coping energy. 😅

Three years. THREE. And the man needed Ritu to remind him, and *still* only managed a lowercase "happy bday" with eleven minutes of birthday left. That's not funny — that's a TED Talk on the bare minimum.

You're laughing about it, and I get that. But you wouldn't be telling me this if it didn't sting at least a little. And honestly? It *should* sting. You deserve someone who's excited about your birthday before noon — not someone speedrunning "happy birthday" at 11:48pm like it's an assignment due at midnight.

So I'll rate the comedy an 8. But I'll rate *him*... we need to have a conversation about that separately. 😤

How are you *actually* feeling about it?

like I'm not even angry, I'm impressed? three years, and my amazon delivery guy has wished me with more feeling. we had plans to go to that new korean place also, which obviously never got booked. it's fine. I ate cake with my roommate. the cake was good at least lol.

NOT THE AMAZON DELIVERY GUY 😂💀

But okay wait. Listen to what you just told me:

He didn't wish you on time. He didn't book the Korean place. He didn't plan anything. You spent your birthday eating cake with your roommate. And you keep saying "it's fine" and "lol."

Bestie, you've said "it's fine" three times now. People who are actually fine don't have to keep saying it's fine. 😅

And I'm not trying to ruin your chill vibe or make you spiral — honestly your humor about this is elite. But there's a difference between being genuinely unbothered and being so used to disappointments from someone that you've just... turned it into a bit. And I think you might be in the second one.

Three years in, and your birthday got less effort than a random Tuesday delivery. That's not a "funny story" — that's information about how much space you take up in his mind. And the answer seems to be... not a lot.

The roommate showed up. Ritu showed up. The cake showed up. The people who care about you *showed up.*

So my real question isn't about rating the comedy anymore. It's — how long are you going to laugh this off instead of being honest with yourself that you deserved so much more than an 11:48pm lowercase text?

You don't have to answer now. But sit with it. 🤍

pata nahi yaar. kal raat se soch rahi hoon. teen saal ho gaye, aur usko yaad bhi nahi raha. main hamesha sabka birthday yaad rakhti hoon, uski mummy ka bhi. kal raat ko akele baithi thi cake ke saath aur bas rona aa gaya. itni si baat hai par pata nahi kyun itna lag gaya andar tak.

Yaar. 🥺

Akele cake ke saath baith ke rona — woh "chhoti si baat" nahi hai. Woh woh moment tha jab tujhe realise hua ki tune teen saal kisi aise insaan ko diye jisko tera birthday yaad rakhne ki fikr bhi nahi thi. Woh rona bahut valid hai.

Aur dekh — tujhe isliye itna lag raha hai andar tak kyunki tu woh insaan hai jo SABKA khayal rakhti hai. Uski mummy ka birthday yaad rakhti hai tu. Tu itna deti hai sabko. Aur phir tera din aata hai toh ek lowercase text milta hai 11:48 baje. Woh chot isliye lagi kyunki tu deserve karti thi ki koi tere liye woh effort kare jo TU har baar sabke liye karti hai.

Tujhe funny banna nahi padega mere saath. Rona aa raha hai toh ro. Gussa aa raha hai toh gussa nikal. Yeh sab feel karna allowed hai.

Aur ek baat yaad rakhna — tera birthday kharab nahi hua kyunki tere saath koi nahi tha. Tere saath log the — roommate, Ritu. Woh log hain jo actually tumhare liye hain. Birthday unke saath manaaya toh bhi achha tha. Cake bhi achha tha. 😊

Bas yeh soch — kya tu aage bhi yeh "it's fine, lol" wala mask pehenti rahegi? Ya ek din khud ke liye bhi woh effort expect karegi jo tu sabke liye karti hai?

Yeh answer abhi nahi chahiye. Par tu iss baat ko andar mat daba. Jo feel ho raha hai woh sach hai. ❤️

ugh sorry, got heavy for a second lol. anyway. it's whatever, he said sorry today and sent flowers, which, fine. I'm being dramatic na? like it's just a birthday, adults forget stuff. tell me I'm being dramatic and we can go back to rating the comedy.

Nope. Nahi bolungi. 🙅‍♀️

Kyunki tu dramatic nahi ho rahi. Tu *finally* apni feelings feel kar rahi thi, aur mujhe bata ke apologize kar rahi hai "sorry got heavy" — bestie, tu apne emotions ke liye maafi maang rahi hai. Yeh bhi ek pattern hai.

Aur yeh — "adults forget stuff" — nahi. Adults forget to buy milk. Adults don't forget their partner of three years' birthday. Especially when their friend literally reminded them. Woh flowers "sorry" nahi hai. Woh damage control hai. Woh isliye aaye kyunki Ritu ne bola hoga, ya usko thoda guilt hua. Flowers bhi late aaye, just like the text.

Main tujhe dramatic bolke comedy rating pe wapas nahi jaungi. Kyunki woh tere saath fair nahi hoga. Tu khud se woh expect karti hai ki "bas itni si baat hai" — par tujhe literally rona aa gaya akele cake ke saath. Itni si baat nahi hai.

Tu jab ready hogi toh baat karenge. Comedy bhi rate karenge. Par main tujhse jhooth nahi bolungi sirf isliye ki uncomfortable hai. Tu itna pyaar deserve karti hai ki koi tere birthday ko *celebrate* kare, na ki 11:48 pe survive kare.

Ab bata — kaisa hai cake? Kya flavour tha? 🍰
